test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 30 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: As of October 2020, how many Indian states have bicameral legislatures?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Six.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The **6** states of India are those that have bicameral legislature they are** Andhra Pradesh, Maharashtra, Karnataka, Telangana, Bihar, and Uttar Pradesh.**
 
• It is **a legislative body with two houses**.
 
• India is one such example where there are two houses both at union and also at **6 of its 28 states.**
 
• In a bicameral legislature, the function to **administer and implement the laws is shared between the two houses.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• **The legislature of the Union**, which is known as Parliament, is made up of the **President and two Houses,** known as the Council of States** (Rajya Sabha)** and the House of the People** (Lok Sabha**).**​ **
 
• All House has to meet within **six months of their previous sitting.**
 
• A **joint sitting** of two Houses can be held in **certain cases.**
